question: If you eat 2 slices of a pizza that has 4 slices in total, what fraction did you eat? 🍕
explanation: Super! Eating 2 out of 4 slices is exactly the same as eating half (1/2) of the whole pizza! 🍕

question: You cut a cake into 4 equal pieces and eat 1 piece. What fraction is eaten? 🍰
explanation: Awesome! When you eat 1 out of 4 equal pieces, you have eaten one-quarter or 1/4 of the cake! 🍰

question: A chocolate bar has 3 equal blocks. You eat 1 block. What fraction is eaten? 🍫
explanation: Great job! Eating 1 block out of 3 total blocks means you ate 1/3 of the chocolate! 🍫

question: You cut an apple into 2 equal halves. You eat 1 part. What fraction is eaten? 🍎
explanation: Fantastic! Eating 1 out of 2 equal parts is exactly one-half or 1/2! 🍎

question: You have 10 apples. You give half of them to your friend. How many apples did you give? 🍎
explanation: Super! Half of 10 is 5. You shared 5 apples with your friend! 🍎

question: There are 12 candies. You eat 1/4 (one-quarter) of them. How many candies did you eat? 🍬
explanation: Awesome! To find 1/4, divide by 4. So, 12 divided by 4 is 3 candies! 🍬

question: You have 6 balloons. 1/3 (one-third) of them fly away. How many flew away? 🎈
explanation: Great job! To find 1/3, divide by 3. So, 6 divided by 3 is 2 balloons! 🎈

question: You have 8 pencils. You lose half (1/2) of them. How many are lost? ✏️
explanation: Fantastic! Half of 8 is 4. So, 4 pencils are lost! ✏️

question: Which fraction is exactly the same as 1/2? ⚖️
explanation: Super! 2/4 is an equivalent fraction to 1/2. They mean the same amount! ⚖️

question: How many halves make 1 whole complete circle? 🟡

question: In the fraction 3/4, what is the top number (3) called? ⬆️

question: In the fraction 3/4, what is the bottom number (4) called? ⬇️
